stem: 5 year old boy developed loud breathing and cough. His mother gave him salbumatol 4 times but did not improve. His loud breathing (not sure if wheeze or stridor in original question) was persistent. An expiratory CXR showed a hyperinflated lung that did not decrease in size on expiration CXR (can’t remember if bilateral or unilateral air trapping – anyone?).
